correctness.rationale: For the fixed point of 0->01 and 1->00, all ones lie in odd positions; 11 and 0000 are absent. A circular odd-length n>=5 word with two ones has some rotation forcing a one at each parity; fewer ones force 0000, so no fully present cyclic classes. At odd lengths 1,3 exactly two classes occur. At even length 2m, the factor language consists of the even and odd zero-insertion images I(v),J(v) of length-m factors of the complemented fixed point; rotating by two corresponds to rotating v, giving a bijection on fully represented cyclic classes and L(2m)=L(m). Thus support is n=2^a or 3*2^a, value 2; independently reconstructed substitution factors and complete rotation orbits for n=1..55, not an infinite proof.
